mentions.name: RetryForge
mentions.description: This tool helps SaaS companies facilitate, track, and recover lost revenue from failed Stripe subscription payments. It shows failed payments from the company owner's perspective: why payments fail, which recovery approaches work best, which step of the process is most successful, and which customers are most at risk right now.
mentions.problem: SaaS companies lose revenue to failed Stripe subscription payments and lack visibility into why payments fail and which recovery steps work best.
mentions.audience: SaaS company owners looking to track and recover lost subscription revenue
mentions.source_excerpt: I created a tool to help facilitate, track and recover lost revenue from Stripe subscriptions for SaaS companies. Called RertyForge, www.retryforge.com
